instruction: Complete the task entirely in the Abaqus/CAE graphical user interface. Use the N-mm-MPa unit system. Create a 3D deformable solid block 120 mm long in global X with a 12 mm by 8 mm Y-Z cross-section. Define Aluminum with E = 70000 MPa and nu = 0.33, assign a solid homogeneous section, and create one dependent instance. Create a Static, General step named Step-Load. Apply Encastre to the X = 0 end face. At the center of the X = 120 mm end face, create a reference point at (120, 6, 4), kinematically couple the complete end face to it, and apply a concentrated force CF1 = +800 N at the reference point. This coupled force, rather than pressure, must produce tension in +X. Mesh the block with C3D8R elements and a global seed size of 4 mm. Create and run Job-BlockTension. Review S11 near X = 60 mm and U1 at the loaded reference point. Save C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-BlockTension.cae and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-BlockTension.odb.
